cohort: 102 preterm newborn infants with gestational age of 30 weeks to 33 weeks and 6 days admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: The Urinary Uric Acid / Cr ratio in the first 24 hours after birth was significantly higher in preterm neonates who underwent intubation, NCPAP or cardiopulmonary resuscitation compared to healthy neonates.
mod_finding: The UUA/Cr ratio was significantly higher in females born by cesarean section.
